_comment: Faerie-canonical Obsidian Linter settings. Drop these values into .obsidian/plugins/obsidian-linter/data.json (merge, don't replace — preserve user-set fields). Optimized for: markdown links in frontmatter (not wikilinks), single-line inline arrays, multiple quote styles tolerated, relative paths with ../, Breadcrumbs hierarchy fields preserved untouched.

_format_examples_for_breadcrumbs._breadcrumbs_hierarchy_uses_NSEW_not_upd: Faerie's canonical bearing vocabulary is N/S/E/W. Register N/S/E/W as the four Breadcrumbs hierarchy axes in .obsidian/plugins/breadcrumbs/data.json userHiers. Semantics: N=unblock(parent/prerequisite), S=ship(child/deliverable), E=parallel(sibling/sister), W=baseline(prev/anchor).
_format_examples_for_breadcrumbs.note: Linter must NOT touch these. Format is fully under faerie control. Wikilinks NOT used — markdown links are canonical for linter compatibility.

yaml-key-sort._why: Sorting frontmatter keys reshuffles up/down/same/prev order which breaks navigation reading order.

format-yaml-array._why: Default to inline arrays: down: [a, b, c] instead of multi-line. Per user preference.

escape-yaml-special-characters._why: Don't auto-escape — our values are deliberately formatted as markdown links and quoted paths. We do our own escaping.

force-yaml-escape._why: Off — would mangle our markdown-link frontmatter values.

yaml-title._why: Title is part of our schema; linter rewriting it would clobber our charter / dashboard title format.

insert-yaml-attributes._why: We declare the full schema explicitly per dashboard / charter / manifest type. No auto-insertion.

remove-yaml-keys._why: Charters/manifests carry custom keys (charter_id, intent_address, etc) that the linter doesn't know. Removing them = data loss.

convert-bullet-list-markers._why: Normalize body bullets to '-' but doesn't touch frontmatter.

no-bare-urls._why: Off — our charters and manifests reference URLs verbatim and we want them bare in some contexts.

convert-spaces-to-tabs._why: Keep spaces — Dataview tables break on tabs.

format-tags-in-yaml._why: Tags-only formatter; doesn't touch our hierarchy fields.

yaml-timestamp._why: We control timestamps in frontmatter explicitly (created, eta, last_updated). Linter timestamps would race our values.

ruleConfigsForAnnotation._documentation: When Linter encounters a faerie-flavored note (charter/manifest/dashboard), it should leave frontmatter alone except for the safe operations enabled above. Body markdown gets normalized; YAML hierarchy + custom keys are sacrosanct.

_faerie_canon_notes: Markdown links in frontmatter: up: '[Note](Note.md)' or up: "[Note](path/to/Note.md)". Single OR double quotes both fine.
Inline arrays default: down: ['[A](A.md)', '[B](B.md)']. Multi-line only if explicitly preferred.
Reserved hierarchy fields: up, down, same, prev, next — keep these inline-array-formatted.
Reserved faerie fields (NEVER strip/rewrite): charter_id, charter_ref, intent_address, actual_address, cluster_prefix, alignment, trail, bearing, displacement, heading_start, heading_end.
Linter ignores forensics/ folder entirely (canonical record is sacred).
